methodology.approval: User requested that Basketball, Running, and the worth-considering audit items go live on 1 November 2026.
methodology.scope: Seven new cards, one separate Gerbera Vol. 2 phase, and expansions to three existing cases. Supporting social runs, City Run with Urbeat, and challenges are grouped in the existing community case.
methodology.metrics: Top-level public counters from two detailed datasets collected on the same day. Missing and negative fields are null. Counts remain scoped to each named post collection. Gerbera editions remain separate.
methodology.attribution: Descriptions state documented campaign ideas and published work. No new personal ownership of sales, deals, attendance, production, or creative credits is asserted. Published partner and creator credits are preserved.
methodology.preservation: Existing account totals, project snapshots, original source associations, and earlier supplemental archives are retained.
methodology.assets: Original public source frames, locally stored as WebP covers and square-cropped previews. Full source posts remain linked. Unavailable image downloads use existing previews where available.

campaigns.title: Drive 2.0 × Cleo.
campaigns.description: A product collaboration connecting a lightness-led running message with Cleo Smart Run, creator content, and an online release.
campaigns.cover_alt: Cleo and Ardiles collaboration reveal above a city skyline
details: Project overview
Drive 2.0 × Cleo brings together running footwear and hydration through a message of lightness, freshness, and daily movement.
Published work
The July–August sequence covers the collaboration reveal, product details, launch at Cleo Smart Run in Bekasi, creator stories, online availability, and reviews.
Content results
The counters below cover 14 explicitly named Cleo posts from 22 July to 4 August 2026. Generic adjoining teasers are excluded.

campaigns.title: Gerbera Challenge: Creative Video.
campaigns.description: A series of creator videos showing Gerbera in outdoor settings, followed by the Dirty in Style open call for a second edition.
campaigns.cover_alt: Gerbera trail footwear shown on an outdoor route in a featured creator video
details: Project overview
The Gerbera creative-video series features different creators and outdoor perspectives, showing the product in use beyond studio photography.
Published work
Ten creator features ran from December 2025 to January 2026. The later Dirty in Style Vol. 2 announcement appears below as a separate phase.
Content results
The first set of counters covers the ten featured videos only. It is separate from the Vol. 2 recruitment posts and the earlier Gerbera Cross Jumper launch.

campaigns.title: Ardiles Running Club.
campaigns.description: A free, all-pace running club, introduced through coach profiles, registration, training updates, and race-related stories.
campaigns.cover_alt: Ardiles Running Club kickoff announcement for 6 June 2026 in Jakarta
details: Project overview
Ardiles Running Club invites beginners and experienced runners to train at their own pace, with coaches and free public registration.
Kickoff
The published invitation names 6 June 2026 at Chatime–Soulfull Hub by F&B ID, Hang Tuah, Jakarta. Coach introductions include Harris, Ariefin, and Rayhan.
Published work
The seven linked posts document the kickoff invitation, coach introductions, registration, later training communication, and marathon-related club stories.

campaigns.title: Run & Recharge × EJ Sport.
campaigns.description: A free 5K fun run in Surabaya, supported by nutrition, apparel, and running-community partners.
campaigns.cover_alt: Run and Recharge 5K fun run invitation for 15 February 2026 at Fork Tunjungan
details: Project overview
Run & Recharge connects a free 5K community run with partner communication around nutrition and apparel.
Event
The event invitation names 15 February 2026 at Fork Tunjungan, Surabaya. The published sequence features EJ Sport, Kniel, and Indorunners Surabaya.
Published work
Eight linked posts cover the invitation, partner announcements, participant preparation, and event recaps.

campaigns.title: Metora 3.0: Hybrid Training.
campaigns.description: Product stories connecting gym sessions, interval running, and hybrid training through Metora 3.0.
campaigns.cover_alt: Metora 3.0 training shoes in the launch product artwork
details: Project overview
Metora 3.0 is presented for training that moves between the gym and running, giving the product a different use case from race-day footwear.
Published work
Eight linked posts cover product introduction, gym and interval stories, product details, and later hybrid-training content.
Content scope
The collection spans February–June 2026. Its counters describe published product content across that period.

campaigns.title: We Are All Runners.
campaigns.description: A brand message about everyday progress: running a little farther toward personal goals, one day at a time.
campaigns.cover_alt: Faces from the We Are All Runners brand film
details: Project overview
The film brings the Run For Your Dream message into everyday life through the line We Are All Runners.
Published idea
The caption connects running with making progress toward personal goals, rather than presenting life only as a race.
Published work
The original brand film was published on 30 May 2025. The public counters below belong to that one post.

campaigns.title: Running Stories with PGL Films.
campaigns.description: Running-culture comedy and everyday observations from PGL Films, Pelari Galau, and their collaborators, sponsored by Ardiles.
campaigns.cover_alt: Hansaluft in an episode of the Ardiles-sponsored running comedy series
details: Project overview
Four published posts use running-culture humor and familiar everyday experiences to connect with runners.
Creator credits
The original captions identify PGL Films as producer and Ardiles Running as sponsor. They credit Hansaluft, Pelari Galau, and Tika Tatum across story, script, talent, and video roles.
Published work
The collection spans March–April 2023, including two running-comedy episodes and the series holiday message. Original creator credits remain with the source posts.

campaigns.title: Gerbera Challenge Vol. 2
campaigns.description: Two May–June 2026 announcements introduce Dirty in Style: an open creator call, 30 creator slots, Gerbera footwear for selected creators, and three best-video prizes totaling Rp9 million. These are the published program mechanics; the counters below cover these two announcement posts separately.

campaigns.title: Original Sense Pro 2.0 launch
campaigns.description: Fifteen January–February 2025 posts document the original Sense Pro 2.0 release, product construction, and early creator tests. This launch phase has its own public-post counters, separate from the 2026 After Image update above and the paid CPAS case.

campaigns.title: Runergize Stay Fast activations
campaigns.description: Nine explicitly named Stay Fast posts document product trials and city activations alongside Runergize communication. Eight source posts already appear in the original case; the additional link below completes this selected set. These counters describe this nine-post activation collection without replacing the original snapshot.
